title: AZ-900 · Describe Azure networking services · Describe Azure virtual private networks

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure networking services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure virtual private networks
questions.question: Which statement best describes Virtual private network (VPN)?

options.text: An encrypted tunnel that carries trusted private-network traffic across an untrusted network such as the internet
An endpoint with a private IP address inside a virtual network
A specialized VM that performs network functions such as firewalling or WAN optimization
The private connectivity path used to connect a site to Microsoft cloud services

questions.explanation: Virtual private network (VPN) is an encrypted tunnel that carries trusted private-network traffic across an untrusted network such as the internet.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure networking services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure virtual private networks
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Azure VPN Gateway refer to?

options.text: Using an internet-based VPN gateway as an alternate path if an ExpressRoute connection becomes unavailable
A DNS zone used for custom private name resolution within Azure virtual networks
A VPN model that uses routing to determine which traffic enters encrypted tunnels and is preferred for many modern scenarios
A virtual network gateway used to create encrypted connectivity between Azure and other networks or devices

questions.explanation: Azure VPN Gateway is a virtual network gateway used to create encrypted connectivity between Azure and other networks or devices.

questions.question: Which description correctly matches Site-to-site VPN?

options.text: A VPN connection between an on-premises network gateway and an Azure virtual network
A virtual network gateway used to create encrypted connectivity between Azure and other networks or devices

A VPN connection between virtual networks

questions.explanation: Site-to-site VPN is a VPN connection between an on-premises network gateway and an Azure virtual network.

questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of Point-to-site VPN?

questions.question: What is the primary meaning of Network-to-network VPN in Azure fundamentals?

options.text: Redundant connectivity at ExpressRoute peering locations for higher availability
A resource containing inbound and outbound rules that allow or deny network traffic
A VPN connection between virtual networks
An endpoint with a public IP address that can be reachable from the internet

questions.explanation: Network-to-network VPN is a VPN connection between virtual networks.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure networking services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure virtual private networks
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Azure VPN Gateway: a virtual network gateway used to create encrypted connectivity between Azure and other networks or devices.
Site-to-site VPN: a subdivision of a virtual network address space used to segment resources.
Virtual private network (VPN): an encrypted tunnel that carries trusted private-network traffic across an untrusted network such as the internet.
Azure VPN Gateway: the default resiliency configuration in which a standby VPN gateway instance can take over during failure.
Virtual private network (VPN): a VPN connection from an individual client device to an Azure virtual network.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Virtual private network (VPN) — an encrypted tunnel that carries trusted private-network traffic across an untrusted network such as the internet; and Azure VPN Gateway — a virtual network gateway used to create encrypted connectivity between Azure and other networks or devices.
